title: File:Kenji Onuma, Tan Howe Liang, Henrik Tamraz 1958.jpg
depicts: 1958 Asian Games lightweight podium in Tokyo: Tan Howe Liang (centre, 'SINGAPORE' vest) with Kenji Onuma and Henrik Tamraz
note: The only openly licensed photo of him competing. Tiny (300x267). Licence is {{PD-Iran}} (an Iranian source, author unknown): public domain in Iran, US status not stated. Usable small, or as the base for a line trace rather than a full-bleed photo.

title: File:TanHoweLiang-TeamSingapore-2008SummerOlympics-20080825.jpg
depicts: Tan Howe Liang (far left, white polo) at the homecoming ceremony for Team Singapore after the Beijing 2008 Olympics, where the table-tennis women won silver
note: 25 Aug 2008. This is the moment he stopped being Singapore's only Olympic medallist after 48 years. A crowded frame: crop to him.

title: File:Tan Howe Liang at the opening of the YOG Learning Centre, Singapore - 20081030.jpg
depicts: Tan Howe Liang, aged 75, standing beside a display case at the opening of the Youth Olympic Games Learning Centre, 30 Oct 2008
note: 640x425 only. Clear face and posture. The case behind him holds sports memorabilia; the source does not say whose.

title: File:Palazzetto dello Sport sportcsarnok. Fortepan 58007.jpg
depicts: Exterior of the Palazzetto dello Sport, Rome, the hall where he won silver on 8 Sep 1960
note: Fortepan, photographed in 1963, three years after his lift. Black-and-white and period-right for an archive-framed spread.

title: File:Kallang stadium zz.JPG
depicts: The old National Stadium at Kallang during one of its last football matches, June 2007
note: He worked as a gymnasium supervisor at the National Stadium from 1982. Snapshot quality; shows the pitch, not the gym.
